opening_assignment: round-robin by fixed pair index, rung and internal direction; each two-game group uses one identical opening with model colors swapped
promotion_rule: A challenger advances when its total score over the paired two games is at least 1.0 (win=1, draw=0.5, loss=0); a failed route is never reactivated
internal_ladder_rule: For B/C/D pairs, the shared 50ms-vs-50ms result evaluates both directions. Later X-to-Y levels use X at the current rung against Y fixed at 50ms; the reciprocal route is separate and is run only if active.
a_policy: unchanged rule selector, natural elapsed time, no artificial sleep and no configured per-move deadline
timeout_policy: Use a returned legal move after timeout and record it; an illegal move forfeits; incomplete games are never counted.
random_seed_policy: Stable SHA-256 seed derivation from base seed and unique group/game/move IDs; frozen before execution.

algorithm_constraints.A: Existing heuristic rule selector; natural runtime.
algorithm_constraints.B: Existing pure Minimax iterative deepening and deadlines; no Alpha-Beta.
algorithm_constraints.C: Same B evaluation, candidate generation, ordering and iterative deepening; only Alpha-Beta is enabled.
algorithm_constraints.D: Unchanged V4C MCTSAgent, tactical rules and cross-move tree reuse; only the current rung budget changes.

inference_limits.sample_warning: Each advancement decision uses two games from one fixed opening with swapped colors. This is exploratory; passing does not establish stable superiority.
